identity.description: An attacker uses AppleScript via the command line to access sensitive application data, triggering detection for unusual AppleScript behavior. Cortex should detect the execution of osascript with suspicious parameters and file access patterns.

expected_artifacts.description: Download of AppleScript from remote server

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Uncommon AppleScript Execution via Command Line
biocs.description: Detection of osascript process started with unusual parameters or file access
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'osascript'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name != 'bash' and causality_actor_process_image_name != 'zsh'
| filter action_file_path contains '/tmp/scratch/'

abiocs.name: Suspicious AppleScript Behavior Accessing Sensitive Data
abiocs.description: Detection of AppleScript accessing sensitive application data via command line
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'osascript'
| filter action_file_path contains '/Applications/' or action_file_path contains '/Library/'
abiocs.causality_anchor: osascript process started with file access to sensitive paths
